model_fit_failed: The frozen model, inputs, environment, optimizer, and valid full run executed the complete budget, but at least one frozen hard gate failed.
model_fit_promising: All frozen hard gates and lineage/boundary checks passed in the one LPWM technical-overfit run. This is a narrow technical result only.
not_executed_resource_block: Environment, CUDA, source/interface construction, optimizer execution, budget completion, or visual-only input boundary prevented a valid full run.
medium_failed: The sealed E1R deterministic visual medium regressed or its prerequisite review is invalid.
